period.timestamp_semantics: interval ending; physical range is (start, end]
period.selection_rationale: One month is the reference period so the whole grid re-runs in CI. November 2022 is chosen because it is the hardest month in FY2022-23: 38% of intervals are negative-priced and 18 and 20 November are negative in all 288 intervals, so the exclusivity reduction and negative-price charging are exercised rather than assumed.

validation.checksum_definition: SHA-256 of pandas uint64 row hashes after sorting settlementdate, regionid, rrp
